If I tell them nothing, they'll smell the blood in the water the moment their scouts glide over our lines. If I move my forces, I'm just shifting the vulnerability to a different flank—amateur hour. 

The only way to handle a predator is to make them believe you're the bigger beast. We lie. We inflate the numbers.
